macro_truck_buttons.vba: Sub Macro_n(): Range("C24").GoalSeek Goal:=n, ChangingCell:=Range("C20"): If Range("C20").Value > Range("C19").Value Then Range("C20").Value = Range("C19").Value
macro_truck_buttons.closed_form: C20 = MIN(n * C22 * C16, C19)  (C24 is linear in C20, so goal seek converges to this to within Excel's goal-seek tolerance ~0.001 on C24)
